objective: Restore cumulative lifecycle gate compliance for the frozen-reference completion PR without weakening the gate.

baseline.status: CI cumulative gate failed because PR changes outside configs/process/cycles lacked a cycle record.

correctness.after: all meaningful PR changes represented by machine-readable cycle record

reproducibility.after: cycle record captures the exact corrective rationale

evidence: This record is process metadata only; it does not weaken or bypass scientific validation.

root_causes: PR-143 changed workflow/documentation files but did not add a configs/process/cycles record recognized by the cumulative gate.

findings: Every meaningful PR, including documentation and workflow changes, must carry a machine-readable cycle record.
